items.abstract_or_text: # v0.33.0 ## Highlights This release features 927 commits from 389 contributors (122 new)! * **New models**: Reflection Beam-1.0 (501B MoE, 23B active) with its DFlash2 drafter (#62074), Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B (#57963), Recursive Flint (40B MoE, 2.5B active) (#62938), Muse Spark Open (#61879), Step-5 Preview (#61727, #63147), NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super (#62957), Nemotron-Labs Dory1.0-4B (#60149), Nemotron Parse 3.5 (#61651), MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (#63095), Domyn Edge (#62544) and the ColUltraVBERT visual document retriever (#62237). * **PyTorch 2.14**: vLLM is upgraded to PyTorch 2.14.0, with torchvision 0.29.0 and Triton 3.8.0 (#52183). * **CUDA 12.9 dropped**: release wheels and images are CUDA 13.0 only. The CUDA 12.9 wheels and the `-cu129` / `-cu129-ubuntu2404` images are no longer published (#62575); use the default CUDA 13.0 artifacts instead. * **libtorch ABI stable CUDA wheel**: the CUDA wheel is now ABI stable with libtorch. * **AWS EFA image**: a new `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0-efa` image (x86_64 and aarch64) bundles the AWS EFA libraries and the EFA build of the Mooncake transfer engine, for KV transfer and multi-node serving on EFA-enabled EC2 instances (#58768). * **`vllm/vllm` image alias**: every release image is now also published under the shorter `vllm/vllm` name, e.g. `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-efa` and `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm`. * **Speculative decoding**: the new XPress refiner for block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash and DSpark (#54448); FLy, an opt-in lossy verification policy with 1.04-1.31x decode throughput on MI355X and B300 (#53987); DFlash/DSpark no longer reserve draft slots in the token budget, taking DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash + DSpark on GB300 from 1373 to 3390 output tok/s in the PR's benchmark (#59468); quantized draft `lm_head` (`draft_lm_head_quantization`, +18% decode at concurrency 1) (#59973); lookahead block hashes so EAGLE/MTP prefix-cache hits keep their last block, on by default (#61589); and MTP drafts in the Transformers modeling backend (#61270). * **Faster decode on NVIDIA**: opt-in latency-specialized decode on GB300 for Kimi-K3 (1.5-2x at TP8/TP16, #61867) and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (18.3% faster decode step at batch 1, #61868); DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MXFP4 experts run as block FP8 through Humming on Hopper (+9-21% decode on 4x H200, #61875); FA4 sparse MLA decode on Blackwell (#55866); FlashInfer DCP prefill on trtllm-gen with 39-48% lower mean TTFT at 100k input on 8xB200 (#62029); and decode-only full CUDA graphs under MRV2 prefill context parallelism (2.6x over eager, #62377). * **AMD ROCm**: the default ROCm image and wheels move to ROCm 10.0, with ROCm 7.2 still published as `-rocm72` (#58761); MonoKernel decode via `--monokernel` for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on MI300X/MI325X (2.32x P50 interactivity at concurrency 1, #60731) and on every MI355X layer (#61082), and for MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 on MI355X (16.6% lower TPOT, #62712, #62994); the `ROCM_OCTAVE` 3-4 bit KV cache (4.6x the KV tokens of fp16 on RX 7900 XTX, #59774); and gfx1250 enablement for gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiniMax-M3 (#58800). * **API and serving**: the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/decisions` endpoint, on by default for supported generation models (#60465, #61550); token embeddings with optional late chunking on `/v1/embeddings` (#61772, #63051, #60164); `output_mode="derender"` on `/inference/v1/generate` (#60082); a large Rust frontend parity push, including no more HTTP 500 on long conversations (#62374) and unsupported flags failing at startup (#62431); concurrent worker startup with TP > 1 (#60028); and a watchdog that dumps stack traces from stuck engine and worker processes (#55700). * **Breaking changes**: Medusa and the MLP speculator removed (#61701); the legacy Ray compiled-graph executor removed (#61712, #62228); `--mamba-cache-mode` deprecated (#60043); requests sent while generation is paused now get HTTP 503 (#51488); the NIXL connector needs NIXL 1.5 or newer (#61032); LM Format Enforcer and `--ir-op-priority` deprecated (#63423, #63371). ## Release Artifacts ### Python Wheels | Platform | Install | |---|---| | PyPI (CUDA 13.0) | `pip install vllm` | | PyPI (CUDA 13.0, uv) | `uv pip install vllm --torch-backend=auto` | | ROCm 10.0 | `pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.33.0/rocm100` | | ROCm 7.2 | `pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/rocm/0.33.0/rocm72` | | XPU | `uv pip install vllm --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/0.33.0/xpu --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/xpu --index-strategy unsafe-best-match` | ### Docker Images | Platform | Docker Image | |---|---| | CUDA 13.0 (Default) | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0` | | CUDA 13.0 + AWS EFA | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:v0.33.0-efa` | | ROCm 10.0 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.33.0` | | ROCm 7.2 | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:v0.33.0-rocm72` | | CPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-cpu:v0.33.0` | | XPU | `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai-xpu:v0.33.0` | Every image is also available under the shorter `vllm/vllm` name: `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-efa`, `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-rocm` (`-rocm100`, `-rocm72`), `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-cpu` and `vllm/vllm:v0.33.0-xpu`. `latest` works the same way, e.g. `vllm/vllm:latest-rocm`. ### Other Artifacts Pre-built release artifacts are available in the **Assets** section at the bottom of this page, including: - Source distribution tarball - CUDA 13.0 Python wheels for x86_64 and arm64 - CPU Python wheels for x86_64, arm64, and macOS - XPU Python wheel for x86_64 ## Model Support * **New models**: Reflection Beam-1.0 (`BeamForCausalLM`) day-0 support with its DFlash2 drafter and fused Blackwell kernels (#62074, #62042), plus `beam` reasoning and tool parsers (#62052); Yandex AliceAI-Foundation-80B-A3B (Kimi Delta Attention hybrid, 512-expert MoE, 262K context) (#57963); Recursive Flint BF16 and NVFP4 GGUF checkpoints with small-batch Blackwell decode kernels (#62938); Muse Spark Open (#61879) with reasoning and tool parsers (#62207); Step-5 Preview (#61727, #62126, #62132), running on SM100 (#63147) with LoRA (#62498); NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super (#62957); Nemotron-Labs Dory1.0-4B (#60149); Nemotron Parse 3.5 with an MTP proposer on MRV2 (#61651); MiniCPM-OCR 1.0 (#63095); Domyn Edge (#62544); ColUltraVBERT (#62237); LFM2.5-Embedding-350M (`Lfm2BidirectionalModel`, #62201); Kolibri 1 through the Transformers backend (#60827); and Decision 3.0 models (#61565, #61778) and Cloudflare Clef-Flash (#61308) on `/v1/systemone`. * **DeepSeek-V4 and V4.1**: length-aware decode indexer block selection (about 850 us saved per step at 1M context, #61039); MegaMoE experts loaded directly in the DeepGEMM layout so `reload_weights` works (#60096); `fused_wqa_wkv` split by token across TP on SM90 (#58872); MegaAttn `wo_a` writes MXFP8 input for `wo_b` (#60118); native small-head FlashMLA sparse prefill on SM90 (#61615); FlashMLA interleaved KV layout (#61371); redundant EPLB expert slots loaded (#59611); GPU Engram tables read from peer HBM, fixing DEP decode hangs on GB200 (#62091); and fixes for Engram under PP (#62208), Engram all-to-all hangs (#62269), prefill index-workspace NaNs (#60613), C128 compressed-KV writes under PIECEWISE graphs (#59709), routed-expert rows under replay (#61643, #62652) and the updated 1017 reference encoding (#62199, #62200). * **GLM**: GLM-5.3-Flash defaults to an FP8 KV cache (9.8% higher end-to-end throughput in the PR's benchmark, #61228) and gets mHC TileLang decode kernels on Blackwell (#62745); GLM-5.3 per-token-group quant (2.8% ITL, #60927), in-place draft decode metadata (#61873) and skipped `concat_and_cache_mla` scales (1.2-3.0% TPOT on B300, #62102); FP8 indexer WK pairs kept across `load_weights` calls, fixing thinking loops with runai_streamer (#59223). * **Kimi-K3**: KDA RecoverSSM CuTe DSL verify/commit kernels on SM10x, with verify records moved out of the KV cache so KV connectors work (#63045); online quantization of NVIDIA projections (#62980). * **Qwen**: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 QSA KV cache on Ampere (#60602, #60992), packed NVFP4 PLE embeddings that fit Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 on one DGX Spark (#56273) and PLE short-conv prefill checkpoints (#61601); FlashInfer GDN prefill checkpoints for Qwen3-Next / Qwen3.5 (#60050). * **Other models**: Cohere2MoE attention/MoE dual stream, single TP all-reduce and fused add + RMSNorm (1.14-1.36x TPOT, on by default, #62101); Beam TP all-reduce fused with norms and MoE finalize (#62366); MiniMax-M3 CUTLASS MSA decode crossover (#55838); Granite MoE as an EAGLE3/DFlash/DSpark target (#61110); NemotronHMTP sharing target embeddings (#62194); LoRA for BERT cross-encoders and token classification (#61279, #61391). * **Multimodal**: PaddleOCR-VL batched vision encoder (34-85% more throughput, #61458) and `compile_mm_encoder` (#61838); DeepSeek-VL2 ViT full CUDA graphs (#46005); Gemma4Unified batched embedding (#60643); Pixtral real-valued RoPE under compile (#63145); and fixes for EXAONE-4.5 images (broken since v0.29.0, #61104), Gemma 4 encoder graphs (#61365, #60687, #63538), DeepSeek-VL2 encoder cache and PP (#63120, #63192) and Gemma 4 placeholders (#61196). * **Transformers modeling backend**: MTP speculative drafts (#61270), fused post-top-k MoE routers (#57410), graph caching instead of AOT caching (#58918) and dynamic-RoPE CUDA graphs (#58064). ## Engine Core * **Speculative decoding**: XPress (#54448), FLy (#53987), no draft-slot budget reservation for DFlash/DSpark (#59468), quantized draft `lm_head` (#59973), lookahead block hashes (#61589), MRV2 skipping drafts no request can use (up to 7.3% prefill throughput with DFlash, #62784), Triton split-K verify (#56148), varlen Mamba2 decode for adaptive verification (#53036), and fixes for stop-trimmed token counts (#58668), block verification randomness (#61161), MTP block tables (#61174), grammar masks (#52477), EAGLE SWA prefix hits (#62206), DFlash/DSpark Mamba checkpoint reuse (#54163) and PP warmup (#62129). * **Model Runner V2**: batch-sharded sampling for GPT-OSS (#61257) with adaptive verification (#58466), 31-120x faster long-prompt staged writes on GB200 (#62698), encoder towers skipped on later PP stages (0.58-1.27 GiB per stage, #60238), async scheduling kept for ngram (#62521), `input_ids` on later PP stages (#61016), and memory-profiling fixes (#57926, #58243, #61509, #63431). * **Sampling**: Triton top-k/top-p skips the cutoff search for masked logits (up to about 8x, #61213); small-batch split top-p (1.22-2.70x on B300, #61996); and fixes for huge logits and boundary ties (#58231, #62046). * **Startup and reliability**: concurrent local worker startup with TP > 1 (about 50s saved at TP8, #60028); shared Triton JIT compile pool (9-28% faster cold warmup, #61422); engine and worker watchdog (#55700); libgomp fork deadlock fixed (#62884); Fast Start with expert parallelism (#55490) and daemon fixes (#62583, #63451, #63088, #62734, #63506); and SHM broadcast reader memory growth fixed (#63165). * **Memory and performance**: UVA-offloaded MoE experts on the sorted fused-MoE path (+7-19%, #62054); DispatchPooler bypass for homogeneous pooling (up to 10.3%, #62940); linear-time encoder cache free (#62850); sliding-window block tables null freed entries (#60767). * **LoRA**: expert LoRA for MXFP4 MoE on `flashinfer_trtllm` (#61979), text-only LoRAs on multimodal wrappers (#62224), unsupported models rejected at validation (#61884), and fixes for `load_inplace` reloads (#41482), `max_loras` accounting (#60306), SM90 `lora_expand` NaNs (#61906) and wake-up from level-2 sleep (#62358). * **RL**: per-choice `return_weight_versions` (#61347), NCCL M2N transfer with per-parameter meshes (#60934), parameter metadata sent once (#35911), the `ParamMeta` / `iter_full()` / `iter_local()` weight-transfer API (#63256), and a silent MoE weight corruption fix with packed NCCL transfer plus layerwise reload (#62555). * **Batch invariance**: compressed-tensors W4A16/W8A16 (#60524), GateLinear routers (#59985), online FP8 MoE (#57092), and inductor batch-invariant mode under `VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT` (#61118). ## Large Scale Serving * **Context parallelism**: MRV2 PCP decode full CUDA graphs (#62377); PCP for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with prefix caching and SWA bounded replay (#59857, #62183, #62384); FlashInfer DCP prefill on trtllm-gen (#62029); direct DCP all-to-all with strided LSE (#60373); FlashMLA sparse on the a2a DCP backend (#61285). * **HiSparse**: direct reads of GPU-resident KV, fixing OOM with long prompts and a 3.3x slowdown on 1M-token prefill (#60417); faster host pool prefault (#60869); and P/D correctness fixes (#61659, #62739, #63827). * **KV connectors**: NIXL 1.5 strided descriptors (#61032), sleep mode with the pull connector (#59635), mixed hybrid MLA block sizes (#61002) and GQA draft head sharding (#58471); Mooncake sleep mode over RDMA (#59625) and Prometheus metrics (#56939); MoRIIO hybrid and heterogeneous-TP WRITE transfers (#60544, #61726); streaming responses carry `kv_transfer_params` (#40186); fault tolerance extended to P/D, fixing KV block leaks (#56430). * **KV offload**: CPU offload over up to 32 shm files (GLM-5.3 offload startup 63.6 s to 38.3 s, #59546), opt-in same-step small loads (#61961), EAGLE/MTP partial tails in align mode (#61019), lock/unlock and off-thread tiering (#58168), and many correctness fixes (#63266, #60810, #63652, #62929, #63010, #60574, #63655). * **MoE and DP**: DeepEP-v2 fused decode globalize+align (up to 2.01x on H200 EP32, #53911); Elastic EP with an external load balancer (#43202); low-latency CPU all-reduce for DP syncs (#61767) and a DP wave hang fix (#59559); EPLB fixes for MXFP4/MXFP8 scales (#61786) and NIXL reads (#62081). ## Hardware & Performance * **NVIDIA**: Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash latency-specialized decode on GB300 (#61867, #61868); FA4 sparse MLA decode (#55866); opt-in CuTe DSL MLA context prefill (#62069); DeepGEMM MegaMoE with NVFP4 routed experts (#61538) and warmed-up kernels (#60468, #61657); Triton GDN decode tuned on SM100 (#61355); GLM-5.2/5.3 low-latency BF16 GEMM on SM107 (#62843); pre-SM90 FlashInfer spec decode in full CUDA graphs (73.6 to 108.1 tok/s on SM80, #60532); `cooperative_topk` sized by row length (#62171); fused GDN MTP decode for SM80-SM90 in CUDA 12.x builds (#60896); and DGX Spark Qwen4Exp TP2 plans (#61437). * **AMD ROCm**: ROCm 10.0 default image (#58761); MonoKernel decode for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and V4-Pro and MiniMax-M3 (#60731, #61082, #61482, #62712, #62994); `ROCM_OCTAVE` KV cache (#59774); gfx1250 enablement (#58800); DeepSeek-V4 MXFP4 indexer K cache by default on CDNA4 (up to 30.7% lower TTFT, #60834, #63669); AITER MegaMoE fixed-slot dispatch (14-15%, #61262) and shared-expert overlap (#61819); Kimi-K3 Gluon KDA kernels (#57392, #59552) and specialized decode (#60683); Qwen3.5 fused GDN MTP decode (+10-16% on MI350X, #61855); Qwen3.8-Flash-Next native W4A4 (1.9-2.3x, #60816); AITER top-k for sparse indexers on gfx950 (#61943); FlyDSL GDN prefill default on gfx942/gfx950 (#60645); RDNA3 TRITON_ATTN addressing restored (about 18%, #60084); and a MiniMax-M3-MXFP4 startup fix for very large GEMMs (#64567). * **Intel XPU**: SYCL GDN prefill backend selection (#56835), torch MXFP4 linear backend (#51965), SYCL FlashAttention for prefix-LM text batches (#62014) and NIXL 1.5.0 in the image (#60356). * **CPU**: zentorch 2.14.0.1 with float16 on Zen CPUs with AVX512-FP16 (#61411); MRV2 Triton warmup at startup removing an 11-20 s first-request compile (#62888); INT8 W8A8 MoE brgemm (#60740); hybrid-model prefix caching (#61805); and Run:ai Model Streamer in the CPU image (#61382). * **Other**: tpu-inference v0.32.0 with torch 2.14.0 (#63080) and more out-of-tree platform hooks (#62026, #63017, #63601, #63457). ## Quantization * Humming runs DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 MXFP4 experts as block FP8 on Hopper (#61875) and honors `--quantization-config.moe.activation` (#62751); pluggable KV cache data types (#52670); online re-quantization extended to NVFP4 MoE (#60276); Quark MXFP8 routed experts (#63125); MoNe expert-pruning checkpoints (#50415); torch MXFP8 linear backend (#51933); FP8 per-token-group quant 1.15-1.29x faster (#61343); Cosmos3-Edge ModelOpt FP8 (#57393); and a Nemotron-3-Nano NVFP4 garbage-output fix under torch.compile (#61749). ## API & Frontend * **New endpoints and options**: `/v1/decisions` (#60465, #61550); token embeddings and late chunking (#61772, #63051, #60164); `output_mode="derender"` (#60082); `--reasoning-effort-map` (#61094); `--sleep-mode-backend` (#63138); dynamic profiler options on `/start_profile` (#51974); images on `/v1/systemone` (#62181, #62437); Responses `max_tool_calls` (#47112) and prompt-cache fields (#62856); and `/openapi.json` response schemas (#60926). * **Tool calling and reasoning**: linear-time streaming tool arguments for GLM, Gemma 4, Qwen3 XML (2.1 s to 11 ms for a 12 KB call) and MiniMax M2 (#61253, #61494, #62027, #62035); DeepSeek V3 multi-line arguments (#60362); structured output masks grammar-invalid reasoning ends instead of returning 500 (#61574). * **Behavior**: chat `finish_reason` and Responses `status` reflect what happened (#59324); beam search normalizes by generated length so `length_penalty` applies (#62928); automatic truncation reserves one generation token (#62010). * **Rust frontend**: `--trust-request-chat-template` (#62673), `--return-tokens-as-token-ids` (#63318), `--tokenizer` options (#62416), `--custom-histogram-buckets` (#62826) and per-request metrics (#59314); request and response parity with the Python frontend (#62434, #62425, #62426, #62427, #62428, #61949, #62429, #62822, #62663); and the MiniJinja fuel limit only on request-supplied templates (#62374). ## Security * Per-request budgets for downloaded and decoded media bytes (#61226); speculators checkpoint metadata can no longer reference local verifier paths (#61587); `certifi>=2026.10.19` and refreshed CA certificates (#62868); raised floors for aiohttp, Pillow, MCP and multidict (#62835). ## Dependencies * PyTorch 2.14.0, torchvision 0.29.0, Triton 3.8.0 (#52183). * FlashInfer 0.7.2.post1 (#60948, #61913, #63466), humming-kernels 0.1.19 (#62816, #64802), DeepGEMM 2.8.1 and later pins (#61149, #61744, #63253), FlashMLA 2026.09.30 (#61371), TokenSpeed MLA 2.0.3 (#61125, #61689), `nvidia-cudnn-frontend>=1.31.0` (#61465), NIXL 1.5.0 (#60428, #60356) and LMCache 0.5.6 (#62835). * ROCm: AITER v0.1.26 (#61697, #62486) and UCX v1.23.0-rc1 (#62827). CPU: zentorch 2.14.0.1 (#61411). TPU: tpu-inference v0.32.0 (#63080). ## Build * Release wheels and images are CUDA 13.0 only (#62575); new `vllm-openai-efa` Docker target (#58768); ROCm 10.0 is the default ROCm image with ROCm 7.2 as `-rocm72` (#58761); ROCm wheel builds about 4-7x faster (#63105). ## Breaking Changes & Deprecations * CUDA 12.9 wheels and images are no longer published (#62575). * Medusa and the MLP speculator were removed (#61701). The legacy Ray compiled-graph executor was removed and `VLLM_USE_RAY_V2_EXECUTOR_BACKEND` is gone; `RayExecutorV2` is the only Ray executor (#61712, #62228). * Deprecated: `--mamba-cache-mode` (no effect, #60043), `--ir-op-priority` (removal in v0.34.0, #63371), and the LM Format Enforcer structured-output backend (opt-in in v0.34.0, removal in v0.35.0, #63423). * API changes: requests sent while generation is paused return HTTP 503 (#51488); `kv_transfer_params` / `ec_transfer_params` moved to the top level of render output (#61241); LoRA on a model without LoRA support fails at validation (#61884); the RL weight-transfer API now uses `ParamMeta`, `iter_full()` and `iter_local()` (#63256); beam search scores are normalized by generated length (#62928). * Rust frontend: unsupported `vllm serve` flags and request fields fail instead of being ignored (#62431, #62434); request-supplied chat templates need `--trust-request-chat-template` (#62673); an empty `tools` array returns 400 (#63060). * The NIXL connector requires NIXL 1.5 or newer (#61032). * Removed env vars: `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MLA_DCP_VERIFY` (#61628), `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FP4_ASM_GEMM` (#61278) and `VLLM_ROCM_AITER_MEGA_MOE_FUSE_SHARED_EXPERTS` (#61345); `VLLM_ROCM_MONO_DECODE` is replaced by `--monokernel` (#61082). * New defaults: GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 KV cache (#61228); lookahead block hashes for EAGLE/MTP prefix caching (#61589); Cohere2MoE dual stream (#62101); FA4 sparse MLA decode at 16 or fewer query heads per rank on Blackwell (#55866); ROCm: AITER FP8/FP4 BMM for MLA off (#53123), FlyDSL GDN prefill (#60645), AITER `topk_gating` (#56226), `rms_norm_gated` (#60250) and MXFP4 indexer K cache on CDNA4 for DeepSeek-V4 (#63669). ## New Contributors * @4arkeinlvy made their first items.abstract_or_text: webgpu : fix CI by keeping scratch alloc sizes monotonic in batch length (#31422) * webgpu: keep scratch alloc sizes monotonic in the batch length The flash attention vec path and the MMVQ path append a scratch area after dst, but get_alloc_size only accounted for it when the current batch takes that path. The size was therefore not monotonic in the batch length: a graph reserved at n_ubatch (tiled path, no scratch) or at one token did not cover batches of 2 to 19 query rows, and GGML_SCHED_NO_REALLOC builds aborted on an unexpected reallocation. Pass the row count to both path predicates and size the scratch with the row count clamped to the longest batch the short path serves. * nit: align the mmvq pipeline key with clang-format 22 * webgpu: address review @yomaytk, name the mat-vec row threshold **Website:** -
